properties.label: Open horizon hero
properties.text: Float one centred typographic statement above a broad low horizon, with a single white rounded command surface beneath it and open sky around the composition.

properties.label: Generously spaced medium sans
properties.text: Use medium-weight sans typography with generously spaced lines and tiny restrained monospace details.

properties.label: Lavender sky and blue ink
properties.text: Use near-white lavender #f4f6fb, powder blue and deep blue ink #1b2a50.

properties.label: Layered illuminated horizon
properties.text: Build a long curved illuminated edge with several quiet atmospheric value layers and fine grain; keep the visual weight in the horizon rim rather than adding cards.

properties.label: Lifted white command surface
properties.text: Give the white command surface a crisp upper edge and a soft lift shadow.

properties.label: Stable press confirmation
properties.text: Use brief local press or copy confirmation without changing the button width.

properties.label: Near-still atmospheric drift
properties.text: Keep the composition complete at rest; any atmospheric drift is nearly imperceptible and stops when hidden.

properties.label: Wide horizon acceptance
properties.text: On mobile preserve the horizon as a wide surface rather than a circular glow, and verify that pale controls and body copy remain readable.
